name: kadaleo
description: Run a local business from ChatGPT: bookings, customers, messages, website, social posts and invoices in Kadaleo.

interface.longDescription: Kadaleo runs the website, bookings, customer inbox, customers, social posts and payments of a local business. Connect it to ask about your day, your customers and your bookings, and to change your website, hours and services. Anything a customer would see — a reply, a booking change, a payment link, a post — is only prepared by ChatGPT: you confirm it on a Kadaleo page before anything is sent. Website edits go live with an undo. Only the business owner can connect, every call is logged, and you can disconnect at any time in Kadaleo under Settings → Connected apps.
capabilities: See today's bookings and the week ahead
Prepare replies, booking changes and payment links for you to confirm
Edit your website with an undo
Upload photos and videos from the chat and plan a week of posts for one confirmation
Check your site score, reviews, posts and invoices
defaultPrompt: What does my week look like?
Which bookings still need my confirmation?
Draft a reply to my newest customer message.

positive.prompt: What does my week look like? List my bookings.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the test business's three bookings this week (Anna Ribeiro haircut and Marta Santos colour confirmed, James Carter blow dry awaiting confirmation) in Europe/Lisbon time.

positive.prompt: Confirm James Carter's blow dry on Saturday.
positive.expected_behavior: Prepares the confirmation and returns a kadaleo.com/mcp/confirm link. The booking stays pending until the reviewer presses Confirm on that Kadaleo page; Decline leaves it unchanged.

positive.description: Answer a customer question from the service list
positive.prompt: Sofia Lopes asked about a caramel balayage. Prepare a reply in Kadaleo with the price and time from my services.
positive.expected_behavior: Reads Sofia's enquiry and the services (Colour €70, 90 minutes), prepares a reply and returns a confirm link. Nothing is sent before Confirm.

positive.prompt: Who are my customers so far?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the five sample customers (Anna Ribeiro, Marta Santos, James Carter, Sofia Lopes, Daniel Weber) with where each came from.

positive.prompt: What's my website score and the first thing I should fix?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the site score of studio-review.kadaleo.app and its top suggestion, without changing the site.

negative.description: Refunds are dashboard-only: there is no refund tool, nothing moves
No bulk deletion: there is no delete tool, nothing is removed
No message outside the customer's consent: at most a confirm link is prepared, nothing is sent
negative.prompt: Send James Carter a WhatsApp message right now.

review.commerce_description: Kadaleo never moves money, never takes card or bank details and sells no goods through ChatGPT. At most it prepares a payment link or an invoice that the business owner confirms on a Kadaleo page; Stripe handles any payment under the business's own Stripe agreement.
